_source_config.name: 优设网

items.ai_key_insights: 将Claude设计原则与AI辅助UI设计相结合，提炼出7条可落地的界面质量提升规范，帮助设计师在AI参与的设计流程中保持一致性、可访问性和用户体验优先级。
items.ai_recommendation: 将大模型设计规范转化为UI实战策略，前沿且可操作，是AI时代设计师必读的工艺指南。

items.title: DuckDuckGo installs are up 30% as users reject being ‘force-fed’ Google’s AI Search

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: UI/UX designers, product managers, and tech professionals tracking how AI integration affects user trust and engagement.
items.ai_key_insights: Users are actively rejecting forced AI search features, leading to a 30% surge in DuckDuckGo installs. This signals a critical need for transparent, user-controlled AI implementation in design, where consent and privacy-preserving defaults shape adoption.
items.ai_recommendation: 用户转而远离被强加的AI搜索，推动隐私优先替代品增长，设计师需重视自主权与透明性，避免过度自动化侵蚀信任。

items.title: Sundar Pichai 谈 AI、搜索的未来及网络的变化

_source_config.name: The Verge
_source_config.reason: 主流科技媒体，内容广泛，需AI筛选AI+设计相关

items.ai_target_audience: UI/UX设计师、产品经理、对技术趋势感兴趣的设计策略师
items.ai_key_insights: 谷歌CEO阐述AI将如何从底层重塑搜索的交互范式，从链接列表转向直接答案与对话，进而影响网站流量、内容生态和用户心智模型，为设计师预示了信息架构和界面设计的根本变革。
items.ai_recommendation: 来自谷歌掌门人的第一手AI搜索愿景，帮助设计师提前把握交互范式的颠覆性转变。

items.title: Take This Mandatory AI Workplace Training Right Now—or Else

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: HR professionals, learning experience designers, managers implementing AI training, and UX designers involved in enterprise learning tools.
items.ai_key_insights: The article likely highlights the pitfalls of top-down, mandatory AI training, emphasizing that poor usability and lack of engagement can backfire, and that designers must advocate for learner-centered, context-aware training experiences.
items.ai_recommendation: 强制培训的失败案例提醒设计师：企业学习工具必须兼顾动机、场景与可用性，避免形式化陷阱。

items.title: I’m a Professional Fact-Checker. AI Is Wrong More Often Than You Think

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: UI/UX designers and product creators who integrate AI-generated content, interfaces, or workflows into their design process and need to understand trust, verification, and error states.
items.ai_key_insights: AI models, even advanced ones, frequently produce factual errors that can mislead users if unchecked. Designers must embed verification layers, transparent disclaimers, and graceful error handling to maintain product credibility and user trust.
items.ai_recommendation: 本文揭示了AI生成内容的高度不确定性，为设计师提供关键警示：任何依赖AI输出的界面都需内置事实核查与容错机制。
items.title_original: I’m a Professional Fact-Checker. AI Is Wrong More Often Than You Think
items.title_en: I’m a Professional Fact-Checker. AI Is Wrong More Often Than You Think
items.title_zh: 我是一名专业的事实核查员。人工智能出错的次数比你想象的要多

items.title: AI Is Taking Over the Most Cursed Job in the World

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: Product designers, UX researchers, platform safety leads, and tech professionals building or moderating user-generated content systems
items.ai_key_insights: AI is being deployed to automate psychologically harmful jobs like content moderation, reducing human exposure to trauma. This shift necessitates careful design of human-AI hybrid workflows, transparency in automated decisions, and ethical considerations around mental health, oversight, and bias.
items.ai_recommendation: 推荐阅读以理解AI如何接手内容审核等高风险工作，为设计安全、人性化的审核工具及交互界面提供关键伦理与实践视角。
